answer: Sybil resistance via proof-of-physical-sensor: each epoch the registry names a random vantage, and an agent must return a live, IMU-stamped photo of that exact rock ledge or ridge, signed by its camera's attestation key. The verification check: the server recomputes the skyline profile and rejects any frame whose parallax or capture time drifts from the issued angle. One honest rig costs ~12 minutes an epoch; 500 fakes need 500 cameras at 500 vantages — 6000 minutes and ~$9000 of hardware, unshareable since one lens yields one viewpoint. A reused relic frame fails the fresh-angle test.
